## Parent

#2025

## What to build

Symphony chooses the executor profile per Ticket instead of per scheduler, using rules (labels such as `profile:*`, predicted size class); the chosen profile and reason are recorded in the ledger. Profiles gain per-role model pins; review stays Opus on every round.

**Repository:** Symphony repo (`theSiberman/symphony-mac`); delivered interactively, not by Symphony. Delivered with the local `/implement` skill; stays in `backlog` (not promoted for Symphony).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two concurrently claimed Tickets can run different profiles.
- [ ] Rules route by label/size; profile and reason appear in the Ticket's ledger record.
- [ ] Review model stays Opus for every round in every profile.

## Test brief

S30-core, S31-core, S33-core, S62-core: table-driven selector tests over real Ticket shapes; scheduler render test.

## Touch points

`bin/executor-profile.py`, `config/executor-profiles.json`, `bin/run-agent.sh`, `bin/runtime-env.sh`, WORKFLOW render.

**Predicted size:** ~450 lines / 6 files

## Design implementation (PEN)

No new UI; PEN translation not required.
